tasks.gr11-microorganisms-disease-t1: Topic: Micro-organisms and Disease. Cover the four groups of micro-organisms (viruses, bacteria, protists, fungi), their ecological roles including decomposition and nitrogen fixation, biotechnology uses such as fermentation and antibiotics, and how micro-organisms cause disease through infection pathways. Ask Grade 11 learners to classify micro-organisms, explain disease transmission, interpret disease-prevention strategies, and distinguish between beneficial and harmful micro-organisms.
tasks.gr11-biodiversity-plants-t1: Topic: Biodiversity of Plants. Cover the four plant divisions — bryophytes (mosses), pteridophytes (ferns), gymnosperms (cone-bearing), and angiosperms (flowering plants) — focusing on evolutionary trends such as vascular tissue, seeds, pollen, and flowers. Ask Grade 11 learners to compare structural features across plant groups, explain advantages of seeds over spores, and identify adaptations related to reproduction and dispersal.
tasks.gr11-biodiversity-animals-t1: Topic: Biodiversity of Animals. Cover major invertebrate phyla including Porifera, Cnidaria, Platyhelminthes, Annelida, Mollusca, Arthropoda, and Echinodermata, focusing on body plans, symmetry (bilateral vs. radial), cephalisation, and germ layers. Provide a vertebrate overview covering the five classes. Ask Grade 11 learners to identify phyla from descriptions, compare body plan features, and arrange phyla in order of increasing complexity.
